title: Registration creates an account and a patient record
preconditions: Email and mobile not yet registered
input: Submit the registration form with valid details
expected: User and patient rows exist; the user is signed in and sees the patient dashboard

title: Duplicate email is rejected
preconditions: An account exists for the email
input: Register again with the same email (any letter case)
expected: Form re-displays with an 'already exists' error; no new rows

title: Duplicate mobile number is rejected
preconditions: An account uses the mobile number
input: Register with a different email and the same mobile
expected: Mobile field error; no new rows

title: Valid credentials sign in
input: Sign in with the correct email and password
expected: Redirect to the role's home page; session id regenerated

title: Wrong password shows a generic error
input: Sign in with a wrong password
expected: Message does not reveal whether the email exists; not signed in

title: Account sign-in is limited after 5 failures
input: Fail sign-in 5 times, then use the correct password
expected: Attempt refused with 'Too many sign-in attempts' for 15 minutes

title: Logout ends the session
input: Sign out, then open /patient
expected: Redirected to sign-in

title: Reset link expires after 30 minutes
input: Use the link 31 minutes later
expected: Link unavailable page; password unchanged

title: Reset link works only once
input: Set a password, then use the same link again
expected: Second use refused

title: Forgot-password response does not reveal accounts
input: Request a reset for a registered and an unregistered email
expected: Identical confirmation for both

title: Patient cannot open the admin dashboard
input: Open /admin
expected: HTTP 403 page

title: Patient cannot view another patient's request
input: Patient A opens /patient/requests/{id of B}
expected: HTTP 404; no data from B shown

title: Phlebotomist cannot record another phlebotomist's collection
input: Phlebotomist Y posts to /staff/tasks/{id}/collect
expected: HTTP 404; status unchanged

title: Guest confirmation page is limited to the submitting session
input: Open /test/confirmation/{ref} in a new session
expected: HTTP 404

title: Guest request is saved with a unique reference
input: Submit the new-patient form
expected: Patient, request, symptoms and history rows created; reference matches VQ-YYMMDD-XXXXX

title: Existing patient request uses saved details
input: Submit the request form (no personal fields)
expected: Request linked to the account's patient record

title: Repeated submission of one form creates one request
input: Submit the same form token twice
expected: One request; the repeat shows the first confirmation

title: Second active request of the same test type is refused
preconditions: Patient has an active RT-PCR request
input: Request another RT-PCR test
expected: Validation message; no new request

title: Preferred date in the past is refused
input: Submit with yesterday as the preferred date
expected: Preferred date error

title: Full workflow from submission to released result
input: Assign, collect, start processing, record result, release
expected: Each status recorded in history with actor; patient notified; result visible only after release

title: Invalid status transition is refused on the server
input: Attempt to release a result directly
expected: Workflow error; status unchanged

title: Patient cannot cancel after sample collection
input: Patient posts to cancel
expected: Error message; status unchanged

title: Reassignment keeps exactly one current assignment
input: Reassign to another phlebotomist
expected: Old assignment ended; exactly one current assignment

title: Search by mobile number and date range
input: Filter by partial mobile and a date range
expected: Only matching requests listed; count correct

title: CSV export neutralises spreadsheet formulas
input: Export CSV
expected: Cell is prefixed with an apostrophe

title: New request notifies administrators and can be marked read
input: Submit a request; admin marks the notification read
expected: Unread count rises then falls; read time stored

title: Comment is hidden until approved and shown escaped
input: Submit a comment containing hi; approve it
expected: Not public while pending; after approval shown as literal text

title: Honeypot submission is discarded
input: Submit with the hidden website field filled
expected: Success shown; nothing stored

title: SQL injection in report filters is harmless
input: Search name = ' OR 1=1 --
expected: No error; no rows unless a name literally contains the text

title: POST without a CSRF token is refused
input: POST /login without _token
expected: HTTP 419

title: Security headers are sent
input: Request any page
expected: CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options and Referrer-Policy present

title: Configuration files are not served
preconditions: Server running with public/ as web root
input: GET /.env
expected: HTTP 404; no file contents

title: Database outage shows a safe 503 page
input: Open a page that needs the database
expected: HTTP 503 with a friendly message and no stack trace

title: No horizontal scrolling at 375 px
input: Open key pages at 375 px wide
expected: Document width equals viewport width

title: Reduced motion leaves all content visible
input: Open the homepage
expected: No reveal animations; all content visible immediately

title: Guest request can be completed with the keyboard only
input: Tab through and submit the new-patient form
expected: Every control reachable with visible focus; errors linked from the summary
